name: CodeBlock
summary: Source code to read and copy: the code scrolls sideways in its own region, and a copy action at its top end confirms on itself ("Code copied") or says, under the code, when the browser won't allow it. Not for a token or a key inside a sentence (use Code).
a11y: The code region is focusable and named by `label`, so keyboard users can scroll it. The copy action keeps focus while it works and confirms in its own name; a failure is announced in a status line that offers the way out.

keys.action: moves to the code region, then to Copy code
scroll the code region while it has focus

props.name: code
props.description: The source, exactly as it should be copied.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the scrollable code region, e.g. "Code: Icons".

props.name: wrap
props.description: Long lines wrap instead of scrolling sideways: for a narrow panel (a design tool's Dev mode), where reading beats keeping the layout of the source. Copying still gives the source exactly.
